definitions.explanation: A person who is timid, easily frightened, or cries easily. Used as a mild insult or teasing term, especially among children.

examples.japanese: {弱虫|よわむし}！⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧な。
examples.english: Don't be a crybaby! Stop crying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弱虫|よわむし}だった。
examples.english: I was a wimp when I was a kid.

examples.japanese: {弱虫|よわむし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧で、⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I didn't want to be called a coward, so I mustered my courage and took on the challenge.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (weak) and ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (bug/insect). The ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ suffix is used in several Japanese words to describe personality types, similar to English expressions like "bookworm."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弱虫|よわむし}な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: a timid child
- {弱虫|よわむし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called a wimp
- {弱虫|よわむし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧: to overcome one's timidity

RELATED WORDS WITH {虫|むし}:
- {泣|な}き{虫|むし}: crybaby (focuses specifically on crying)
- ⟦{怠|なま}け→怠ける：02379_namakeru⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧: lazybones
- {本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧: bookworm

USAGE:
Most commonly used by or about children. Among adults, it is playful or teasing rather than a serious insult. Can function as a な-adjective when modifying nouns: {弱虫|よわむし}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a timid personality).
